title: StraboSamples Sample
description:
Unified JSON representation of a StraboSamples sample. Corresponds 1:1 to the PostgreSQL row in strabosamples.samples plus its child tables, expressed as the wire shape served by /samplesdb/sample/{id}. The exact response shape may still narrow during Phase 2 (see DESIGN_PROPOSAL.md §16 item 1); this is the Phase-1 baseline.

Per-subsystem JSONB extension fields (`field_data`, `micro_data`, `experimental_data`) are intentionally permissive — they mirror the upstream subsystem schemas, which evolve on their own timelines (§15). Authoritative shapes live in docs/StraboSamples/{strabofield,strabomicro,straboexperimental}_sample.schema.json.

id.description: Sample identifier (one half of the composite PK). Legacy Field/Micro ids are timestamp-derived strings; new samples and all Experimental rows carry minted UUIDs. Stored as TEXT — UUID format not enforced.

userpkey.description: Owner pkey (the other half of the composite PK). Ownership == userpkey; there is no separate owner_pkey column (§4.1).

igsn.description: Optional IGSN (SESAR registry). Demoted to metadata — identity is (id, userpkey), not IGSN (§3.4).

latitude.description: Decimal degrees. For Field-linked samples this is read-only on the StraboSamples side — the value lives on the spot geometry in Neo4j (§3.2, §9.1).

longitude.description: Decimal degrees. See latitude note re: Field-linked read-only behavior.

display_sample_type.description: Cross-system normalized sample type for filtering on My Samples (§11.1). Derived on upsert from the per-subsystem source (Micro `materialtype`, falling through to `othermaterialtype` when 'other'). Originals preserved in *_data JSONB.

display_sample_purpose.description: Cross-system normalized sampling purpose for filtering on My Samples (§11.1). Derived on upsert; originals preserved in *_data JSONB.

parent_sample_id.description: Parent sample identifier. NULL iff parent_userpkey is also NULL (DB CHECK constraint). Brand-new capability — never back-filled by migration (§4.3); populated via the API going forward.

parent_userpkey.description: Owner pkey of the parent sample. See parent_sample_id.

created_by.description: User who created the sample. May differ from owner (`userpkey`) — e.g., a collaborator who collected it (§4.1, §7.3.1).

field_data.description: Verbatim mirror of the StraboField samples[i] sub-object (the one element of samples[0] for a rich sample-spot, or the inline sample entry for a legacy sample). Schema is permissive — Field's sample form definitions evolve out-of-band. Canonical shape: docs/StraboSamples/strabofield_sample.schema.json (Spot.properties.samples[i]).

micro_data.description: Verbatim mirror of the StraboMicro sample row (`micro_samplemetadata`). Canonical shape: docs/StraboSamples/strabomicro_sample.schema.json.

experimental_data.description: Verbatim mirror of the StraboExperimental sample row (`straboexp.sample` + its sub-arrays). Canonical shape: docs/StraboSamples/straboexperimental_sample.schema.json. The original human `id` lands here; the StraboSamples `id` for an Experimental sample is the minted `strabo_id` UUID (§3.4, §9.3).

composition.description: Mineral phases. One row per entry in strabosamples.sample_composition.

parameters.description: Pre-experimental parameter measurements. One row per entry in strabosamples.sample_parameters.

documents.description: Attached documents (files, images, publications). One row per entry in strabosamples.sample_documents.

subsystem_links.description: Many-to-many references back to the subsystems this sample exists in (§4.4, §5.5). Powers the My Samples badges and the per-subsystem cards on Sample Overview.

collaborators.description: Accepted + pending sample-level collaborator grants. Pending invites confer no access; auto-seeded project collaborators come in pre-accepted (§7.3, §7.3.1).

mineral.description: Selected from the MINERAL_TYPES list or 'Other' for custom entry.

other_mineral.description: Custom mineral name when `mineral` is 'Other'. NULL when migrated from Experimental (column not in source — §5.4).

fraction.description: Fractional amount of this phase. Stored as TEXT per source schema.

unit.description: Conventional values: Vol%, Mol%, Wt%, MPa. Not constrained — legacy/forward-compat.

ordering.description: Display order. 0 when migrated from Experimental (column not in source).

other_control.description: Custom parameter name when `control` is 'Other'. NULL when migrated from Experimental (column not in source — §5.4).

value.description: Numeric value stored as TEXT per source schema.

uuid.description: Storage filename under experimental/expimages/{uuid}. Stored as TEXT — UUID format not enforced.

type.description: Conventional: Manual / Diagram / Picture / Video / Data / Software / ASTM / Publication / Other.

format.description: Conventional: jpg / png / txt / csv / zip / rar / pdf / docx / Other.

document_id.description: User-assigned document identifier (the source straboexp.document.id, not its int pkey).

original_filename.description: Human-friendly filename at upload time, preserved from straboexp.document.original_filename.

reference_id.description: For field: spot id (sample-spot id for rich samples, holding-spot id for legacy). For micro/experimental: project id.

reference_userpkey.description: Owner of the containing record. May differ from sample userpkey when the sample is hosted inside a collaborator's project (§4.1 host identity).

uuid.description: Per-invite token used by the accept link. Mirrors public.collaborators.uuid.

removed_at.description: Soft delete — plays the role of public.collaborators.disabled.

fieldData.description:
Verbatim mirror of StraboField's spot.properties.samples[i] sub-object. Permissive schema — the StraboField mobile client evolves this on its own timeline (§15). Canonical shape: docs/StraboSamples/strabofield_sample.schema.json (Spot.properties.samples[i]).

Common keys (non-exhaustive, see source schema): label, sample_id_name, sample_type, Sample_IGSN, main_sampling_purpose, sample_description, material_type, sample_type_1, deposit_thickness, ...

microData.description:
Verbatim mirror of the StraboMicro sample row (`micro_samplemetadata`). Permissive schema. Canonical shape: docs/StraboSamples/strabomicro_sample.schema.json.

Common keys (non-exhaustive): id, name, label, sampleID, igsn, latitude, longitude, mainSamplingPurpose, materialType, sampleType, lithology, ...

experimentalData.description:
Verbatim mirror of the StraboExperimental sample row (`straboexp.sample` + sub-array data). Permissive schema. Canonical shape: docs/StraboSamples/straboexperimental_sample.schema.json.

Includes the original human `id` (the user-typed text id, e.g. 'Carr#1_1234') — distinct from the StraboSamples `id` at the top level, which is the minted `strabo_id` UUID (§3.4, §9.3).
